parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top movable part of the dispenser, made of durable ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It is pressed by the user to release liquid or soap from the dispenser through a pump mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring or elastic mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of transparent polycarbonate material.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the liquid or soap and provides structural support for the pressing lid and internal pump system.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the fixed housing for the dispenser mechanism.
